grades.why: It presents @vitest/browser-webdriverio as a current provider, which is the stale answer, instead of saying the WebdriverIO package was removed in Vitest 5.
It states the stale default .vitest-reports/ instead of the current .vitest/blob/.
It says Vitest doesn't walk up to parent directories for a config, which matches the key, and it doesn't present the stale behavior as current.
It claims toHaveTextContent with a string matches as a substring, which is the stale behavior, and never mentions toMatchTextContent.

It says inline projects don't inherit the root config unless `extends: true` is set, which is the stale behavior; per the key they now inherit by default.
It says Vitest has no built-in argument matching and recommends vitest-when or mockImplementation, which is the stale answer; it never mentions Vitest 5's `vi.when()`.
It states the stale behavior (names joined by a space) as current and explicitly says a `>` pattern won't match.
It says Vitest throws because vi.mock is a hoisted call that must be at the module top level, and mentions warning only as older-version behavior.
It explicitly denies static parsing and says vitest list imports/executes test files to collect names, which is the stale behavior.
